messages:
deploybot: [AUTOMATED] Rollout paused for release candidate `rc-2026.03.11` due to incident INC-2026-041 (auth 502s in eu-west-1). Canaries aborted and hold applied across staged lanes. Reason: elevated 5xx spike.

sara: saw it, thanks. canary traffic was ~5% - did it already hit core?

jamal: only canaries in eu-west-1 and eu-central. us-east untouched.

alex: quick ask — do we want a rollback to last stable (v3.4.1) or pin nodes to v3.4.1 and requeue the RC?

morgan_ops: ops oncall here. prefer pin + requeue if DB migrations were part of rc (they were not). less blast radius. DB load is fine at 03:00 UTC if we need replacement window.

priya_pm: PM/CS heads need a single-line customer-facing note. if we pin we'll say "deploy paused due to auth instability; reverting canaries; full rollout rescheduled."

jamal: sounds good. technical decision: pin control-plane routes to v3.4.1 for eu-*; abort canary pods. alex ok to run rollback commands?

alex: I'm going to prepare the rollback command. plan: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/web web=redwood/web:v3.4.1 --record` then `deploybot rollback --service auth --to v3.4.1 --reason "INC-2026-041"`

morgan_ops: 👍 will watch and throttle if we see DB churn. ops oncall @oncall-bot please ack and set incident tag to "release-hold".

oncall-bot: @morgan_ops acknowledged. Incident tag updated to `release-hold`. Pager alerts suppressed for deploy events.

sara: alex, after rollback can you update the release notes section and add a short line under "deferred rollouts"? Also capture rollback-gitsha.

alex: will do. pushing notes now and I'll attach the rollback sha in the thread.

priya_pm: customer note draft: "We're pausing today's rollout while we investigate an authentication instability affecting EU regions. We're reverting canaries and will reschedule the rollout during a quiet window. We'll update here when we have a new ETA." ok to send to comms? :thinking_face:

jamal: edit: add "no customer data at risk" to reduce urgency.

priya_pm: done. sending to comms.

alex: rollback executed: `deploybot rollback --to v3.4.1 --services auth,web` — canary pods terminated, stable pods verified. rollback-gitsha: `a1b2c3d`. services show 2xx in eu at 10:12 UTC.

morgan_ops: Verified 200s and steady. Leaving hold on until postmortem and a quick root-cause check from infra. ops suggests reschedule window 03:00-05:00 UTC tomorrow.

sara: tagging follow-ups: 1) add postmortem owner 2) re-run release dry-run against canary infra 3) update release checklist to include auth-side circuit check.

jamal: assigned: priya->comms, alex->rollback doc + sha, morgan_ops->ops verification, sara->release checklist.

priya_pm: noted. I'll draft the comms update and the short release note entry.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-041 updated: status=mitigated, hold_state=manual_hold, next_window_proposal=2026-03-12T03:00:00Z.

alex: quick note for release calendar: I'll move the RC to "staged-requeue" and add a tag `needs-auth-fix` so it doesn't auto-retry.

morgan_ops: +1. ops will schedule a smoke run at the proposed window and we can re-open the deploy once infra confirms auth latency stable for 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
